verdict.rationale: jo's docs say it can read existing decks and generate new ones from outlines. They also say it can build a website and then change it conversationally, which shows iterative editing for that one artifact type. Beyond that, the evidence is a single thin line about decks, with nothing on documents or other file types and nothing on exporting them. Missing for 10: document/file creation beyond decks, iterative editing of decks or documents, export formats/download, independent or hands-on corroboration.
